items.author: Troms politidistrikt
items.body: Kl 0050: En person som nektet å forlate et utested ble bortvist av en patrulje.

items.title: Have you ever interacted with any of the Royals or the Monarchy as an institution?
items.author: BATIRONSHARK
items.body: I sent an email to your king but as I expected I got a form email ..Still pretty cool although I wished to meet him one day.
